ain_dictionary.title: National Ainu Museum dictionary: kopisi
ain_dictionary.support: Distinguishes asking a short question of someone from a substantive inquiry. Also documents impersonal a= and the differing argument structure of konu. Does not validate this API-query sentence.

mnc_grammar.title: P. G. von Möllendorff, A Manchu Grammar (1892)
mnc_grammar.checked: Full historical grammar transcription independently retrieved
mnc_grammar.support: Documents asking with fonjimbi, the -me converb, ability verb mutembi and negative formations. A worked passage uses gucuse de fonjici for asking friends. This is a primary historical text in a public transcription, not a modern computing authority.

bo_terminology.title: CTA Tibetan Terminology
bo_terminology.checked: Home page retrieved; no metadata/query entry successfully retrieved
bo_terminology.support: Review lead only. No lexical validation claimed.

bo_mediawiki.title: MediaWiki Tibetan source catalogue
bo_mediawiki.support: The metadata key uses a different Tibetan term, རྒྱུ་གཞི་གྲངས།. This establishes a terminology alternative, not correctness of either full AN Paint sentence. Other apparent problems in the catalogue mean it is not accepted blindly.

dz_glossary_2007.title: Dzongkha Computer Terms, DzongkhaLinux project / CRULP
dz_glossary_2007.checked: Primary publisher PDF indexed excerpt retrieved; direct PDF fetch timed out
dz_glossary_2007.support: Printed p.157 maps Query to འདྲི་དཔྱད། and shows forms built with འབད. Supports the proposal query noun and verb combination.

dz_glossary_2018.title: DDC, English-Dzongkha Basic Computer Terminology (2018)
dz_glossary_2018.checked: Official indexed entries retrieved for printed pp.67 and 86; direct PDF and screenshot retrieval failed
dz_glossary_2018.support: Uses the alternative metadata term བརྡ་དོན་གནས་སྡུད and query དྲི་བཀོད. Shows terminology variation. The search extraction has typographic noise; do not mechanically transplant the extracted text.

dz_mediawiki.title: MediaWiki Dzongkha source catalogue
dz_mediawiki.checked: Actual upstream file retrieved and metadata entry located
dz_mediawiki.support: The metadata key uses the same loan-plus-data term as the candidate, མེ་ཊ་གནས་སྡུད. Its metadata-help context concerns image/file metadata. This is lexical evidence; it does not certify the new complete sentence.

ko_kp_book.title: JAVA자료기지프로그람작성법, attributed in the book to 교육성 교육정보쎈터
ko_kp_book.checked: 454-page mirrored primary text retrieved; publication identity visible in text, official hosting/authenticity not independently verified; PDF screenshots failed
ko_kp_book.support: Printed p.141 explicitly defines 메타자료(MetaData); p.5 uses 자료요청 for logical requests to a data system. Supports 메타자료 and request wording. Does not attest original 조회 or the complete new sentence.

mn_orthography.title: Official Mongolian orthographic rules, §49.5–6
mn_orthography.support: Foreign words containing back vowels take back-vowel suffixes; words without them take front-vowel suffixes. Applied to the ordinary pronunciation of Commons, this supports Commons-ын rather than Commons-ийн.

mn_metadata.title: National University of Mongolia Open Data: About
mn_metadata.support: Explains мета-өгөгдөл as data about data. Supports metadata semantics, not exact traditional-script spelling.

mn_request.title: Mongolian explanatory dictionary: хүсэлт
mn_request.checked: Original proposal source examined; independent direct retrieval timed out
mn_request.support: A source lead for traditional request spelling; not counted as independently verified in this pass.

unicode_mongolian.title: Unicode 17.0, §13.5.1 Mongolian
unicode_mongolian.support: Separated suffixes require special shaping. Unicode 16+ uses U+180E MVS for this role; U+202F NNBSP remains for backward compatibility. Ordinary space is not a substitute. Which convention works with this Android renderer must be checked. Manchu and Mongolian are separate writing systems despite sharing the block.

ryu_corpus.title: Shinzato and Arakaki, Okinawan Natural Conversation Corpus, 2025
ryu_corpus.checked: Full indexed PDF text retrieved; screenshots failed; exact proposed negative form not independently located in extractable text
ryu_corpus.support: Confirms corpus dialect scope, transcription methodology and past tan. Does not establish the proposal nominal-query plus ability/failure construction. The proposer cited an example whose exact typography could not be rechecked here.

ryu_dictionary.title: NINJAL Okinawa-go Dictionary Database
ryu_dictionary.support: Establishes the Shuri dictionary source and downloadable lexical data, not the modern technical sentence.

hak_query.title: Hakka Affairs Council, Sixian intermediate vocabulary, entry 4-20
hak_query.checked: Primary official indexed entry retrieved (printed p.119)
hak_query.support: 查 caˇ is an inquiry/lookup verb. PFS chhà follows the Sixian pronunciation rather than Mandarin.

hak_fail.title: Taiwan MOE Hakka dictionary: 失敗
hak_fail.checked: Official indexed entry with accent-specific forms retrieved
hak_fail.support: Defines failure as not succeeding/meeting an aim; the relevant Sixian-family form is siid pai. PFS sṳt-phai is the matching orthographic rendering.

hak_data.title: Wiktionary: 資料
hak_data.support: Lists Sixian PFS chṳ̂-liau; used only as secondary orthographic corroboration, not a terminology authority or native certification.

hak_ki.title: Wiktionary: 繼
hak_ki.support: Lists Sixian PFS ki and Taiwanese POJ kè. Used as secondary reading corroboration; neither whole metadata compound is claimed to be a universal written standard.

nan_query.title: Taiwan MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 詢 index / 查詢
nan_query.support: Attests Taiwanese 查詢 tshâ-sûn. The corresponding POJ is chhâ-sûn, retaining tones while converting the orthographic tsh.

jje_grammar.title: Jejueo Research Institute, 2018 language-school materials
jje_grammar.checked: Institutional indexed lesson text independently retrieved; direct page returned 502
jje_grammar.support: Attests 헷수다 as a completed polite form of 하다/허다 in the lesson. The technical subject and compound failure verb remain model synthesis.

jje_corpus.title: Jeju government language education: oral records
jje_corpus.support: Corroborates 헷수다 in oral Jejueo. Does not establish a conventional translation of metadata/query.

vi_nom_reference.title: Ủy ban Phục sinh Hán Nôm, Bảng chữ Hán Nôm chuẩn thường dùng (2023), p.165
vi_nom_reference.checked: Publisher indexed entry independently retrieved; direct PDF fetch failed
vi_nom_reference.support: Provides 與料 dữ liệu. It supports this character mapping rather than Chinese 資料; not the entire modern sentence.

vi_query.title: Thi Viện, Hán Nôm dictionary: 問
vi_query.checked: Full dictionary page and compound index independently retrieved
vi_query.support: Lists truy vấn 追問 and the vấn reading. The historic lexeme does not alone establish its modern computing use; the modern Vietnamese sentence is model-reviewed.

vi_of.title: Chữ Nôm dictionary, U+27D51 𧵑
vi_of.support: Gives của and possessive/of examples, supporting the Vietnamese syntactic link.

jyutping.title: Linguistic Society of Hong Kong, Jyutping scheme
jyutping.support: Supports the romanization and tone-number convention; individual word readings are also model-reviewed. It does not certify the whole sentence.
